title: Cummins India sees strong demand; plans gradual price hikes Strong demand reported across all areas, with data centers contributing 30-40% to power generation sales. Gradual price increases being implemented to offset rising input costs and margin pressure. Q2FY27 sales rose 4% YoY to ₹3,247 crore, but PBT fell 28.4% to ₹601 crore. Domestic distribution sales grew 13%, while power generation domestic sales dipped 2%
